subtitle: The guide fixture's chapters with no profile declared
description: The same three files as `guide/`, with the `"profile": "guide"` line removed so the narration rules apply. Every guide-only construct in them is expected to fail here.
This is the half that proves the profile is doing the work. A checker that had quietly stopped enforcing the narration rules would pass this folder, and running `guide/` alone would never show it.
